summary: Valuence Merger Corp. I, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing the board approved a one-month extension of the deadline to complete an initial business combination from July 3, 2026 to August 3, 2026. The company deposited $13,897.14 into its trust account to fund the extension. The extension is the third of ten potential one-month extensions available under the company's amended charter, allowing deferral up to March 3, 2027. This is a routine operational extension filing common for SPACs, not a definitive transaction or special situation. No negotiations, agreements, or changes in terms are disclosed. The filing merely updates the timeline; trust mechanics remain unchanged.
